items.title: El Salvador has not used public funds to accumulate bitcoin since June 2025, IMF says
items.summary: IMF says El Salvador used no public funds for bitcoin accumulation since June 2025, with purchases coming from private donations.

items.title: Trezor says data breach affects another 67K US customers
items.summary: Trezor said an additional 67,000 US users were affected by its shipping provider’s data breach, opening the path to potential phishing attacks and social engineering scams.

items.title: Zcash jumps 20% to landmark $1,000 level as short sellers lose $34 million
items.summary: ZEC briefly traded above $1,020 as a sharp rally forced traders betting against the token out of leveraged positions.

items.title: FinCEN Ties $12.7B to Crypto Scams Run From Asian Compounds
items.summary: Monthly reported sums rose 18% on average, and the compounds now appear to be spreading beyond Southeast Asia.
